Price indices over the previous period

Source: R/indice.R
pi_py2pp.Rd

Convert price indices expressed over the previous year (average of the previous year = 100, as in the examples 8.2 and 8.3 of the IMF QNA Manual) into price indices over the previous period (quarter or month), as needed by laspeyres(), paasche() and fisher() with reference_freq equal to the frequency of the data.

Usage

pi_py2pp(pi, previous = 100)

Arguments

pi

Price indices over the previous year (ts or mts, quarterly or monthly). Leading and trailing missing values are ignored.

previous

Value, over the previous year, assumed for the period before the first one (default: 100, i.e. the prices of that period are those of the average of its year).

Value

A ts (or mts) of price indices (previous period = 100).

Details

With \(i_t\) the index over the previous year, the index over the previous period is \(100 i_t / i_{t-1}\) within a year, and \(i_t / i_{t-1} \times \bar{i}_{y-1}\) for the first period of year \(y\) (\(\bar{i}_{y-1}\) is the simple average of the indices of the previous year, on which the indices of year \(y-1\) are normalised). This simple average is the normalisation of the indices, not the annual price index used to deflate annual data, which is by default their weighted average (see pi_annual()).

See also

pi_annual()

Examples

pi_py2pp(imf_pi)
#>                 A         B
#> 2011 Q1 102.00000  99.00000
#> 2011 Q2 100.49020  98.98990
#> 2011 Q3 100.48780 100.00000
#> 2011 Q4 100.00000 101.02041
#> 2012 Q1 102.12682  96.51010
#> 2012 Q2  99.51220 102.06186
#> 2012 Q3  99.01961  99.49495
#> 2012 Q4 100.49505 100.50761
#> 2013 Q1 100.74754  99.36869
#> 2013 Q2  99.00498 101.00000
#> 2013 Q3  99.49749 100.49505
#> 2013 Q4  99.49495 100.49261
